page.layout: One page, all centred: title block at the top, a woodcut ornament in the middle, and the imprint at the foot. No margins with text.
page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a grotesque mask with scrolls and tassels) between the Præside line and the imprint, no text. Library oval stamp at the left edge and a handwritten "44" at the top right were left out. The name "Kiessen" in the Præside line is set in a special display face and is doubtful; it is marked in black letter but may read differently. Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The "IIS" in the title is printed as "IIS" (for "iis"), kept as printed.
